The recipe module cannot book an issue of 500 g of flour although 2 kg were
received this morning:

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/bakery/recipes/production.py", line 64, in bake
    ledger.issue(ingredient["item"], ingredient["amount"], ingredient["unit"])
  File "/srv/bakery/vendor/stockbook/stockbook/ledger.py", line 28, in issue
    raise LedgerError(f"stock of {item!r} would go negative ({left:g} kg)")
stockbook.ledger.LedgerError: stock of 'flour' would go negative (-499998 kg)

The ledger had ledger.receive("flour", 2) and then
ledger.issue("flour", 500, "g").
